purpose: Discover versioned permanent-role training source and the continuity stores required for fresh-chat qualification and operational reorientation.
authority_nonclaim: Reading this registry, repository access, BASE_READY status, tool access, or a checkpoint never grants external mutation authority.

one.fresh_chat_rule: A new One chat must prove it is operating from a BASE_READY qualification bound to this exact package version/digest, or execute the package and qualify before operational work. A checkpoint never substitutes for training.
one.working_branch_rule: After BASE_READY, resolve the unique current operational checkpoint leaf and then independently refresh mutable governance/provider/authority facts before action.

nine.source_set_digest_rule: SHA256 over lexicographically sorted training_manifest.json.file_inventory entries encoded as UTF-8 path + NUL + sha256 + NUL + decimal byte_count + LF.
nine.fresh_chat_rule: A new Nine chat must prove a PASS qualification bound to this exact package version/source-set digest or execute the exact package and qualify before operational work. A checkpoint never substitutes for training.
nine.working_branch_rule: After BASE_READY, resolve the unique valid Nine checkpoint leaf, then independently refresh mutable governance, assignment, provider/target, and authority evidence before any acceptance or effect claim.
